question.text: For futures or options contracts NOT officially listed on a market (OTC), the realisation value shall be:

answer.text: Determined by the investment manager using a defined method
Taken as the last exchange settlement of a similar contract

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the chapter: 'The realisation value of futures or options contracts not officially listed on a market or traded on an unregulated market should be the net realisable value as determined by a method determined by the Investment Manager.' The Trap: Zero is absurd; similar-contract borrowing distorts; investee-company reporting is irrelevant. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests OTC derivative valuation. VIII covers ISDA-based OTC practice. Manager's Pro-Tip: For OTC swaps marked at broker mid - always cross-verify against at least 2 independent dealer quotes for daily NAV stability. A single broker's quote at month-end can skew crystallisation.
